svg.title: Left Brain
svg.desc: The left hemisphere: sides of a near-isometric grid drawn by hand, dashed where they only reach, signals firing along them, and marks of mathematics and programming — #, </>, +, =, [ ], { }, and the digits 1, 0, 10, 101, 1101 and 01001 — thrown out of its contour along six lanes, each flung clear at its own angle and carried off by the wind, shrinking as they go.
